overview: Built an automated multi location inventory and replenishment management system for preventing stockouts, reducing overstock, and improving warehouse inventory decisions.

The workflow takes new sales orders and automatically updates inventory, calculates stock health, predicts replenishment needs, manages warehouse transfers, creates supplier orders, tracks deliveries, and monitors slow moving inventory.

list: Receives new sales orders from Shopify or WooCommerce
Normalizes order data from different sales channels
Finds product and warehouse inventory records automatically
Updates available stock after every completed sale
Calculates inventory health, daily demand, and estimated days remaining
Routes products based on healthy, reorder, critical, or out of stock conditions
Logs inventory events and stock risk data in Google Sheets
Searches other warehouses when inventory becomes critically low
Calculates transferable stock without affecting source warehouse safety levels
Selects the most suitable warehouse for internal stock transfers
Creates and tracks warehouse transfer requests automatically
Sends stock transfer approvals through Slack
Retrieves supplier information when external replenishment is required
Analyzes historical sales and demand trends
Generates demand forecasts and stockout probability
Calculates recommended reorder quantities using safety stock, lead time, MOQ, and incoming inventory
Creates replenishment requests automatically
Routes high value replenishment orders for manager and finance approval
Creates supplier replenishment orders after approval
Sends confirmed stock orders to suppliers through Gmail
Creates Google Drive folders for supplier and shipment documentation
Receives supplier confirmations and expected delivery information
Calculates delivery risk against projected stockout dates
Generates alternative inventory actions when supplier deliveries are delayed
Sends critical stockout alerts to the operations team
Reconciles received stock against supplier orders
Updates warehouse inventory after successful receiving
Detects damaged, partial, or incorrect deliveries
Updates supplier performance using delivery and order accuracy data
Scans inventory weekly for slow moving, excess, and dead stock
Generates redistribution recommendations across warehouse locations
Updates inventory analytics and operational reporting automatically

blocks.p: The workflow uses predefined replenishment, transfer, supplier communication, and inventory alert templates.

list: Stock transfer requests
Replenishment approvals
Supplier order communication
Inventory risk alerts
Warehouse receiving notifications

blocks.p: This keeps inventory operations consistent across different warehouses, products, suppliers, and sales channels.
Airtable or SmartSuite acts as the central inventory, supplier, warehouse, transfer, and replenishment tracking system.
Each inventory record is updated with:

list: Current stock
Reorder point
Stock risk
Warehouse location
Supplier information
Transfer status
Replenishment status
Incoming inventory
Supplier performance
Inventory health

result: A complete automated inventory management pipeline that turns every sales transaction into an updated, monitored, forecasted, replenished, and optimized inventory operation without requiring teams to manually track stock across multiple warehouses.
The system also keeps inventory levels, warehouse transfers, supplier orders, delivery risks, slow moving stock, supplier performance, and stock analytics organized in one workflow.
